# AGENTS.md — 21-tech-conference

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Gate 27**, tech conference, style "Airport wayfinding".
- Stack: React 19, Vite. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.js` — schedule, speakers, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/App.jsx` — split-flap components, board, passes
- `src/styles.css` — tokens at the top

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Schedule as a split-flap departures board: letters flip when you switch day or time zone; statuses like BOARDING and FINAL CALL.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Yellow-on-black only for signage (bar, pictograms, CTAs); content sits on concourse grey.
- Board text is uppercase mono on flaps; statuses use green/amber/red like a real FIDS.
- Each column has a fixed flap count so rows align; change widths in Board.
- Times are stored in venue time; 'Your time' converts in the browser.
- Arrows and pictograms point somewhere real (an anchor).

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
